blurr.title: Document Blur Tool
blurr.intro: A document blur tool that lets you search and locate content in PDF documents, then blur it with customizable intensity and page range
blurr.uploadText: Click to Select a PDF Document
blurr.searchPlaceholder: Enter keywords to search page content...
blurr.infoIntro: PDF Blurring: Precisely Locate and Blur Sensitive Content in PDF Documents
blurr.problem1: Blur sensitive information in PDF documents.
blurr.problem2: This tool supports two modes: search-based locating and manual selection — enter keywords to search PDF text content, and matched text areas are automatically marked as blur targets; you can also manually drag-select areas to blur directly in the preview. Customize blur radius (intensity) and page range; the processed PDF maintains the original layout intact.
blurr.problem3: No professional software installation required; use it online anytime, anywhere.
blurr.formatPdf: PDF Text Layer: PDF files contain a text layer (selectable text) and a rendering layer (displayed content). This tool parses the PDF's text layer to get each character's coordinate position, then uses Canvas to draw Gaussian blur effects on the corresponding areas — finally using pdf-lib to re-embed the blurred images back into the PDF.
blurr.featureOnline: Search-Based Locating: Enter keywords to automatically search matching text in the PDF — matching positions are highlighted, and you can mark all matched areas as blur targets with one click.
blurr.featurePreview: Real-time Preview: Results are displayed instantly for easy adjustment and confirmation.

compress.featureLevels: Dual Modes: Smart compression re-encodes images while keeping text selectable; Aggressive compression rasterizes pages for minimum size.
compress.featureCustom: Custom Parameters: Freely adjust image quality and resolution scaling.
compress.featurePreview: Effect Preview: Before/after comparison updates in real time as parameters change.
compress.featureSecurity: Data Security: All data is processed locally and never uploaded to any server.
compress.usageSelectFile: Select File: Click the "Click to Select a PDF Document" button to choose the PDF file to compress.
compress.usageFileLimit: File Limit: Supports PDF files up to 200MB.
compress.usageAutoPreview: Auto Preview: After upload, the tool automatically analyzes document images and displays a before/after comparison.
compress.usageMode: Compression Mode: "Smart (Recommended)" re-encodes only images while keeping text selectable; "Aggressive" rebuilds pages as images for a smaller file but non-selectable text.
compress.usageLevel: Compression Level: Three presets are available: "Low Compression (High Quality)", "Medium Compression (Recommended)", and "High Compression (Smallest Size)", mapping to the quality and resolution of the current mode.
compress.usageCustom: Custom: Select "Custom" to freely adjust image quality (10%-100%) and resolution scaling (0.5x-2x).
compress.usagePreview: Real-time Preview: The compression preview updates live as you adjust parameters, helping you find the balance between clarity and size.
compress.usageProcess: Start: Click the "Start Compressing" button to process the entire document.
compress.usageProgress: View Progress: A progress bar and percentage are displayed during compression.
compress.usageDownload: Download Result: After compression completes, view the size comparison and click the "Download Compressed PDF" button to save the result.
compress.noteSecurity1: All processing is done entirely in your local browser; data is never uploaded to a server.
compress.noteSecurity2: Avoid processing documents containing sensitive information on public devices.
compress.noteProcess1: Do not close the browser or refresh the page during processing, or the operation will fail.
compress.noteProcess2: Multi-page documents may take a while to compress. Please be patient.
compress.noteProcess3: Download the result promptly after processing; the result is lost once the page is closed.
compress.noteEffect1: Smart compression keeps text selectable and vectors sharp; Aggressive compression re-renders pages, so text will no longer be selectable or searchable.
compress.noteEffect2: For text-heavy PDFs with no images, use Aggressive mode; Smart compression has limited effect on such documents.
compress.noteEffect3: Higher compression means smaller size but lower image clarity; use the preview to choose wisely.
compress.noteEffect4: Interactive content such as bookmarks, outlines, and forms will not survive Aggressive compression; Smart compression preserves them fully.
compress.noteFaq1: Upload Failed: Check that the file is a valid PDF and does not exceed the size limit.
compress.noteFaq2: File Got Bigger: Smart compression only replaces images that got smaller and never enlarges the file; text-only PDFs may grow under Aggressive mode. This is normal.
compress.noteFaq3: Blurred Images: Increase image quality or resolution scaling, or switch to the "Low Compression" level.
compress.noteFaq4: Slow Compression: Large multi-page files take longer to process. Please be patient.
compress.noteFaq5: Download Failed: Check your browser's download permission and try another browser.
compress.toastNoJpegImages: No compressible JPEG images detected. Please switch to Aggressive mode
compress.toastPdfLibFailed: Document structure parsing is limited (possibly encrypted). Switched to Aggressive mode

markdown.title: Markdown Editor
markdown.intro: A Markdown editor with live preview, syntax toolbar and extended syntax such as task lists and footnotes, supporting one-click download of Markdown, HTML or PDF files
markdown.toastInvalidFile: Failed to read file. Please select a .md / .markdown / .txt text file
markdown.toastPdfFail: Failed to generate PDF, please try again later
markdown.confirmClear: Are you sure you want to clear all content? This cannot be undone.
markdown.problem1: Write and preview Markdown documents right in your browser without installing any software.
markdown.problem2: See the rendered result in real time while writing, avoiding layout issues caused by syntax errors.
markdown.problem3: Export the Markdown source file, the rendered HTML file or a PDF document with one click for easy sharing and publishing.
markdown.featureEdit: Quick Editing: Insert headings, bold, italic, lists, tables and more with one click from the toolbar.
markdown.featurePreview: Live Preview: Content is rendered instantly, with Edit, Edit+Preview and Preview view modes.
markdown.featureFile: File Management: Open local Markdown files to continue editing, then download as .md, .html or .pdf.
markdown.featureAutoSave: Auto Save: Content is automatically saved in the browser locally and survives page refreshes.
markdown.featureSecurity: Data Security: All data is processed locally and never uploaded to any server.
markdown.usageEdit1: Type Directly: Enter Markdown text in the editor on the left.
markdown.usageEdit2: Toolbar Assistance: Select text and click a toolbar button to quickly apply bold, italic, headings and more.
markdown.usageEdit3: Open File: Click "Open File" to import a local .md / .markdown / .txt file and continue editing.
markdown.usageView1: Edit Only: Focus on writing with the preview hidden.
markdown.usageView2: Edit + Preview: Edit on the left with live preview on the right (default mode).
markdown.usageView3: Preview Only: View the final rendered result in full width.
markdown.usageExport1: Download Markdown: Save the current content as a .md file.
markdown.usageExport2: Download HTML: Save the rendered result as a fully styled HTML file that opens directly in a browser.
markdown.usageExportPdf: Download PDF: Export the rendered result as a PDF document with automatic A4 pagination, ideal for printing and archiving.
markdown.usageExport3: Copy HTML: Copy the rendered HTML source with one click for pasting into blogs or CMS systems.
markdown.noteSecurity1: All editing and rendering happens locally in your browser; content is never uploaded to any server.
markdown.noteSecurity2: Auto-saved data is stored in the browser's local storage and may be lost if you clear browser data.
markdown.noteSyntax1: Supports headings (Setext/ATX), bold, italic, strikethrough, highlight, sub/superscript, quotes, code, ordered/unordered/task lists (nestable), links, images, auto-links, tables, horizontal rules, footnotes and math formulas (rendered by KaTeX, $...$ inline / $$...$$ block).
markdown.noteSyntax2: Rendering of complex nested structures may differ slightly from some platforms; please confirm in the preview before exporting.
markdown.noteFile1: Only .md / .markdown / .txt text files can be opened.
markdown.noteFile2: Please download and save important documents in time to avoid loss caused by browser cache cleanup.
markdown.noteFaq1: Preview not updating: The preview renders in real time; switch view modes to refresh if anything looks wrong.
markdown.noteFaq2: Download failed: Check browser download permissions or try another modern browser.
markdown.noteFaq3: Content lost: Content is auto-saved to browser local storage; download a backup before clearing site data.
